question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"trust."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Trusts"** is grammatically correct as it refers to a specific trust.
 
• A noun typically follows the word** their**.
 
 
• **Example**: *We walked **their**__ dog for them while they were on vacation*.
 
 
 
• **Trust **is an uncountable noun and the plural form of **trust i.e;** more than one (kind of) trust.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

When trust is broken, as it is being done often in the present-day world, the world seems upside down for the people who are suffering due to their trust being broken. When close friends or close relatives break their __**trust**__, it is ______ (2) ______ natural to feel hurt and experience misery. But, ______ (3) ______ a grudge or waiting to take revenge damages both, mental and physical health. This is a very crucial stage for anybody. One needs to understand that he is already suffering and that negative emotions like revenge, grudge, and anger will let him/her down completely. What should one do when ______ (4) ______ trust is broken is the question. Mind coaches, religious gurus and wellness trainers suggest a noble quality of ‘Forgiveness’. It is the quality which we need to practice for our own well-being. It does not simply mean forgetting what happened. It is understanding from others’ point of view. If there is something comprehensible, we can try to repair the relationship. Forgiveness helps to be good and makes one stand high in every human relationship. So, forgiveness is not only powerful but also power-giving. The entire world, along with the lives of the people in it, ______ (5) ______ on trust. ​
